about_the_game:
Awesome Gameplay

Responsive and precise 2D gameplay with an emphasis on movement-enhancing abilities. Double & triple jumps, a wall jump, teleport dash and shape shifting.

Abilities and Magic

A set of magical weapons, each upgradeable and with different trade-offs, selectable via an old-school ring menu.

Excellent Level Design

Six beautiful and unique levels - explore the many rooms of the castle, its mysterious mine or the beautiful outdoor garden!

Secret rooms, treasure chests and hidden tablets with lore to uncover.

A fast travel system with teleport gates that make backtracking much more convenient.

Character Development

An interesting skill tree with a mix of status upgrades, temporary buffs and passive skills such as automatic healing and HP siphoning. Numerous side quests, a shop to buy much-needed potions, and an ingredient collection system to unlock special parts of the skill tree!

Music and Sound

Enjoy beautiful music and sound effects created by Dynamedion.

Dive into a world with unique music for the six sections of Signiverux, each carefully designed.

Be entertained by the sound effects thoughtfully put together, while you explore, fight and learn about the mysteries of this game world!

Many, many thanks to:

Andreas Hammann - Music Composer & Sound Designer

Steffen Brinkmann - Music Composer

short_description: Signiverux is a Metroidvania-inspired action adventure with fluid gameplay and detailed graphics. Explore the depths of a mysterious castle in search for a way back home, enjoy fast ability progressions, search for powerful magic upgrades and grow your character by expanding the skill tree.
supported_languages: English, German, Simplified Chinese, French, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America
